# Code review of pre-Opus-4.8 code — 2026-10-07

The owner asked for a quality pass over code written by older models (mostly
Opus 4.7, before 2026-05-28), aimed at cold load, frame rate, movement, combat
and spellcasting. A `git blame` census against the commit trailers located the
old code (scratch tooling, not committed): `src/lib.rs` still holds ~30,500
Opus 4.7 lines; `index.html`, `scene3d/index.js`, `play_effect_vfx.js`,
`combat-bar.js`, `animation.js`, `camera.js`, `buildings.js` and most of `ui/`
are 45-100 % pre-4.8. Three read-only scouts traced combat/spell/movement, the
per-frame wasm work, and long-session growth; a fourth reviewed the diff
adversarially (no bugs found; its risks are in §4). Every lead was re-read in
the tree before changing anything.

Nothing here was run in a live client (laptop rule: no live sessions; the 1070
needs the owner's OK). Verification is the JS gate, targeted suites, the
real-wasm smoke test and the native Rust suites. §3 is the queued live check.

## 1. Fixes

| # | What the player sees | Where |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | On a plain URL (no `?…`) the particle owner registry was OFF — the opposite of its documented default and of every dev URL — so players ran the legacy emitter bookkeeping (no in-flight tombstones: effects that finished loading after a despawn leaked). The lint had proven this on 2026-10-05 and waived it. (`statics.js`'s blocking-particle-parity copy had the same bug but no visible effect: the other readers were already on.) | `particles/owner_registry.js`, `statics.js`, `scripts/lint-url-flags.mjs`, `docs/url-flags.md` |
| 2 | An interior evicted mid-build re-registered its landblock as a resident LRU entry with no content (and re-ran the light rescan). Deferred item from the 2026-08-03 review. | `scene3d/index.js` `loadEnvCellsForLandblock` |
| 3 | Every cross-LB static batch bucket started at 16,384 verts + 32,768 indices (~0.5 MB) whatever it held — 182 MB at Holtburg for 3-14 instances each, uploaded whole on first sight (PERF-LOG 2026-10-06 lead 1). Now sized from the first feed (2× unique geometry, pow2, 1,024-16,384) and grown as before. | `static_batch_x.js` |
| 4 | Holding a key re-fired one-shot actions at the OS autorepeat rate: a held hotbar key drank extra potions and re-cast spells, a held backtick flip-flopped the combat stance (each repeat flips the in-flight request since `65bcfc06`), held F-keys flickered panels open/closed, held C cycled camera modes. Actions now fire on the press edge unless bound `{allowRepeat: true}` (only spell/tab scrolling; documented on `client.input.bindAction`). The per-use "Hotbar N: use item 0x…" debug line is no longer printed into chat. | `ui/input-funnel.js`, `combat-bar.js`, `hotbar.js`, `index.html`, `app/plugin_bar.js`, `camera.js`, `plugins/api.js`, `docs/url-flags.md` |
| 5 | The first cast of every session ran without its cast table (lazy 2.1 MB fetch): no busy-window guard, no windup clip prefetch, default 2 s / 3 s durations, and the parse landed mid-cast. Both spell tables are now fetched at idle after entering the world (the JSON parse still runs on the main thread when the response lands — see §4). | `ac_spell_cast_sequence.js`, `ac_spell_shape.js`, `app/client_events.js` |
| 6 | wasm-bindgen boxes left to the FinalizationRegistry on per-frame / per-batch paths: the local pose in every `EntityManager.tick` (~60/s), every camera `CollisionHit`, every `client.player.stats` read, every `lookupMotionLinkForSwing` result. | `entities.js`, `camera.js`, `plugins/api.js` |
| 7 | Every stats batch pulled the whole enchantment list three times and left two of the copies unfreed; buffs-hud's tiebreak was O(n²). | `world-state.js`, `status-indicators.js`, `buffs-hud.js` |
| 8 | A PhysicsScriptTable lookup that failed transiently (wasm not up yet, or the fetch threw) was cached as a permanent miss, so that table's effects stayed dead for the session. | `ui/ac_physics_script_table.js` (+ new `test_ac_physics_script_table.mjs`) |
| 9 | `lookupMotionLinkForSwing` copied and parsed the whole MotionTable (44 KB) and its link Animations (~58 KB each) on every call — ~15 calls per level-8 cast (two thirds inside the click handler), 2 per melee click, up to 8 per idle fidget for every idle creature in town. Memoised in Rust (hits and confirmed misses from a resident table; cleared on `init_resource_source`). | `src/lib.rs`, `src/global_source.rs` |
| 10 | Per-frame work inside the synchronous TickMovement hop: the cell-visibility snapshot rebuilt every resident cell's portal geometry, three visibility getters re-decoded all portal polygons per call and others re-scanned every resident polygon; the camera shadow deep-copied the insert-only terrain-height map (growing with every landblock visited) and every entity's pose/body/remote state; the liveness sweep scanned the inventory linearly per tracked guid; the solve request was O(tracked²). Geometry is now cached per `collision_cache_key`, the shadow shares geometry only and refreshes at most every 100 ms, and the scans are set lookups. | `src/lib.rs`, `src/session/commands/movement.rs`, `holtburger-world` (`spatial/scene.rs`, `context.rs`), `holtburger-core` (`client/simulation.rs`) |
| 11 | The always-on `__diag` spawn ledger kept a record per spawn forever and scanned its bucket twice per spawn (~36 µs per spawn at 5k records for one wcid, 750 µs at 50k). Now a 128-record ring per wcid and a 500-entry failure list with a running total. | `scene3d/diag.js` |
| 12 | Every decoded sound stayed in memory for the session (all 786 waves ≈ 360 MB decoded), and one failed fetch silenced that sound until reload. Now a 64 MB LRU; fetch failures retry after 30 s (decode failures stay cached). | `scene3d/audio/audio_manager.js` |
| 13 | The batched-material variant set pinned every statics material ever batched (defeating the `?matBudgetMB` eviction, which relies on GC) and was walked every frame (0.61 ms at 400 variants, 14.2 ms at 8,000). Buckets now hold their variant and release it when reaped; the last release disposes the variant only. `__diag.batchMatVariants()` reports it. | `batched_material_variant.js`, `static_batch_x.js`, `statics.js`, `index.js` |
| 14 | High/Ultra (CSM) shadows: a batched variant shares its member material's `userData`, so the per-material CSM uniforms tracked only the program compiled LAST — the other one (plain mesh or batch) kept compile-time shadow matrices/maps (frozen or wrong statics shadows). The registry also pinned every per-surface material and was walked each frame. All receivers now bind ONE shared set of CSM uniform objects (the `VFX_GLOBALS` pattern), written once per frame. | `scene3d/csm.js`, `scene3d/materials.js` |
| 15 | The movement registry never dropped a destroyed entity: the liveness sweep is the only `EntityDespawned` emitter and its events never reached the registry, so every remote mover ever seen stayed (walked every tick), and a MoveTo armed on a destroyed guid could steer the guid's next occupant. The shared frame spine now prunes them (the local player's entry is kept). | `holtburger-core` `movement/system.rs`, `client/tick_spine.rs` |
| 16 | `container_placement` kept every unlooted item of every corpse or chest ever opened, and the inventory snapshot scanned it once per owned item. `remove_entity` now prunes it. | `holtburger-world` `state/types.rs` |
| 17 | The inventory snapshot (every owned item's property reads, name clone and placement rank) was rebuilt for every world ObjectCreate — ~300 times on a town arrival — although JS reads it at most once per event drain. It is now rebuilt on read when marked dirty. | `src/lib.rs`, `src/session/messages/mod.rs`, `src/session/mod.rs` |
| 18 | Per-landblock caches that never evicted on the default path: the wasm scenery/spawn record caches (~3.7 KB of scenery per landblock, in wasm memory, which never shrinks — the code comment's "under a megabyte" was wrong; all Dereth ≈ 240 MB) and the baked ambient-trigger cache. The first now goes with the landblock on LRU evict; the second is a 256-landblock LRU. | `scene3d/landblock_lru.js`, `scene3d/index.js`, `scene3d/audio/baked_ambient_source.js`, `src/lib.rs` (comments) |
| 19 | Dismemberment leaked GPU geometry on every dismembered kill: an expired corpse archive "handed back" stumps to any parent — but a despawned corpse detaches only its root, so its stumps kept a dead parent and were never freed — and re-slicing / re-chipping a part dropped the previous pass's stump geometry without disposing it. | `scene3d/dismember.js` (+ new `tests/dismember_archive.test.mjs`) |

The wasm was rebuilt (release, `capped-build`) and installed into `pkg/`; the
cache-bust stamp is `wasmrev-20261007c` in `index.html`, the two workers
(`bake_worker.js`, `net_worker.js`) and `net_worker_client.js`.

## 2. Verification

See §2a for the final numbers of the last run (fixes 1-19, build 5).

- New/extended JS checks: `test_input_funnel_v2` §12b (autorepeat), `test_static_batch_x` S1-S3 (bucket sizing) + R1-R5 (variant release on reap), `test_static_batch` H1-H2 (per-LB batch release), `test_batch_mat_variant_clone` (+9 holder checks), `test_visfid_p33_csm` (shared-uniform binding + refresh), `test_ac_spell_cast_sequence` (preload), `test_particle_owner` (bare URL), `test_ac_physics_script_table` (transient retry, new), `test_diag_spawn_classifier` (+4 ledger caps), `tests/audio_manager_retail.test.mjs` (+2 LRU/retry), `test_landblock_lru_evict` Test9, `test_ambient_baked` (+3 LRU), `tests/dismember_archive.test.mjs` (new; its first case fails on the old logic).
- New Rust tests: `spatial::tests::cell_snapshot_tables_bump_collision_cache_key`, `collision_view_keeps_geometry_drops_entity_state_and_restores_source`, `state::tests::test_remove_entity_prunes_item_and_container_placements` (world); `tick_spine::tests::swept_local_player_keeps_its_movement_manager` + the extended `tick_spine_handle_reports_out_of_visibility_prune_despawn` (core).

### 2a. Final run

- JS gate (`capped-build node harness/run-js-headless.mjs`, wasm build 5 installed): **416 passed, 1 failed** of 417. The failure was `harness/test_diag_schema.mjs`: its registry anchors `__diag.runAll` to a line in `scene3d/diag.js` that fix 11 moved. The anchor (and the same entry's note) were updated, and that suite plus the three others that import the schema were re-run green. No product code changed after the gate run.
- `cargo test -p holtburger-world --lib`: **771 passed**. `cargo test -p holtburger-core --lib client::`: **636 passed, 1 ignored**.
- wasm build 5 (release, `capped-build`): 6,828,827 B (build 4: 6,833,380), installed into `pkg/`; `test_wasm_preload_stamp` 7/0, `test_motion_sequence_wasm_smoke` 17/0. A later `cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` of the final tree is clean (the crate's 17 warnings = baseline). The only edits after build 5 are comments and attribute placement, so the installed wasm matches the tree.
- `scripts/lint-url-flags.mjs`: PASS.

## 3. Queued live check (owner-run 1070 batch)

1. **Bare URL** (no query string) at Holtburg: 0 console errors; fight a few monsters until they die mid-effect — `ownerRegistry` holds no records for despawned guids afterwards.
2. **Statics memory**: `scripts/perf-worker/glcensus.js` street sweep — `static-batch-c` geometry uploads well under the 31.5 MB / 182 MB measured on 2026-10-06; no missing props. Also count bucket regrowth (`setGeometrySize`) and long tasks on the same sweep (§4 R5).
3. **Held keys**: hold a potion hotbar key (one drink), hold backtick (one stance change), hold F-key panel hotkeys (no flicker), hold C (one camera change), hold PageDown in magic stance (still scrolls the spell bar).
4. **First cast after login**: windup gestures play on the very first cast; `__diag.cast` shows no `tableNotLoaded`.
5. **Cast / swing hitch**: `t=performance.now(); for(let i=0;i<10;i++) __classifyMotionCommandTyped(0x09000001,0x49,0x10000078); (performance.now()-t)/10` should read microseconds after the first call.
6. **Visibility**: interiors through Holtburg doorways, a dungeon room, the sealed Town Network hub (terrain hidden), portal punch / seal apertures — all unchanged; teleport tour hitches with `?syncTickDiag=1`.
7. **Long roam** (town → a few landblocks out → back): `__diag.batchMatVariants().live` tracks resident buckets (falls after leaving a region); inventory panel updates on loot / drop / equip exactly as before; trees and NPCs come back on re-entry (scenery/spawn caches re-fetch).
8. **High preset** (forced on the 1070): statics shadows move with the sun/camera on both batched and plain props; no shader errors.
9. **Dismemberment**: 20 dismembering kills, walk away until the corpses despawn, wait 10 min — `renderer.info.memory.geometries` returns to its baseline.

## 4. Found, not fixed (owner decisions / follow-ups)

- **Swept entities stay as JS ghost rigs on default URLs.** `?maintPrune` (forwarding the 25 s out-of-visibility despawns to the rig layer as KIND_REMOVE) is still opt-in, so rigs, `WorldObjectManager` entries and the wasm bridge indexes of entities ACE dropped silently stay while you remain within draw range. Fix 15 cleans the Rust registry only, because pruning the bridge caches or the `js_spawned_guids` ledger while the rig lives would be wrong. Flipping `maintPrune` default-on needs the eye test in its url-flags row. Even with it on, the swept guid's bridge indexes are not pruned (handles not plumbed into the TickMovement arm).
- **Hotbar stale-binding prune is dead for characters with server shortcuts** (`hotbar.js` `pruneStaleItemBindings` gates on `reconcileAttempts < 30`, which freezes below 30 once reconcile succeeds). Fixing it changes what happens to a slot whose stack runs out (clear / rebind to another stack of the same wcid) — decide the retail-parity intent first.
- **Targeted casts and missile shots wait for a client-side turn-to-face** (`picking.js` `turnToFaceThenAct`, up to 800 ms). The fixes exist behind `?serverTurn=on` / `?castFacing20=on` and need the eye test before a default flip.
- **R3 — the 2.1 MB cast-table JSON parse** (fix 5) still runs on the main thread when its response lands, usually in the busy first seconds after login. Parsing after a second idle callback (or in a worker) would move it off the critical window.
- **R5 — smaller first buckets regrow more often** (fix 3): each grow is a full CPU copy + GPU re-upload inside the streaming feed; with `statGeomDedup` off a region's buckets regrow ~2-4× instead of 0-1×. Bytes are measured in §3 item 2; count the grows too.
- **R2 — the Node test default for `particleOwner` is still off**, so `test_phase7_batch9_entity_lifecycle.mjs` pins the escape hatch; add an "on" variant.
- **R4 — `SHADOW_REFRESHED_AT` is per thread, not per session**: a reconnected session inherits the previous session's timestamp (harmless today: logging in takes seconds).
- **Shared geometry tables are deep-copied on the first write after each shadow refresh** (now ≤ 1 per table per 100 ms). The full fix is per-entry `Arc` values or dropping the shadow for `world.try_borrow()` reads.
- **The per-tick visibility-prune pass** still runs every frame; throttling it risks pruning an entity that just came back into view.
- `statics_aabbs_near_pose` copies the 3×3 static AABB lists per camera / transition call; `getSkyState` + `getSkyObjectStates` evaluate the sky twice per throttled tick and their boxes are not freed.
- **The shard record cache is unbounded by default** (`?shardBudgetMB`; authors' own note, 307 MB over 6 towns). An ABAB measurement of a ~3× working-set default is still owed.
- **Particle bookkeeping** (scout 3 #10): `particle_manager` `_materialPool` keys rotate on every matBudget eviction of a particle surface and strand their clones; owner-registry ids are removed only on explicit destroy; `_epochs` gains an entry per entity removed.
- Small: `MOTION_ACTIONS` / `MOTION_AXES` are drained only by the rAF loop (a hidden tab accumulates and replays a stale burst on refocus); `_soundTimeoutsForGuid` buckets for long-lived entities grow per play; `_spawnMotionStash` entries for failed spawns linger; `pending_confirmations` are surfaced only by rynth (the default UI never shows fellowship/crafting/allegiance confirmations — a functional gap).
- **Outside the diff** (`?drawPools`, dev only): `cells.js:1983-1991` — an older envcell build that loses the race calls `releasePooledCellsForLb(lbKey)` and also releases the cells a newer build of the same landblock already added.
